title: Case REQ-20261113-LIF005 — death certificate
content:
Certified copy of the death certificate of Mei Chen, received with Robert Chen's death notification on Fri 13 Nov 2026. Case REQ-20261113-LIF005.

Details: Mei Chen; born 05/06/1984; died Mon 12 Oct 2026, aged 42; cause of death: brain aneurysm; occupation: pharmacist; usual residence: Box Hill VIC; spouse: Robert Chen; children: Lily (12) and Max (9). Registered with the Victorian registry of births, deaths and marriages; copy certified by an authorised witness.

Also received: a certified copy of Robert Chen's ID (claimant; CL-101935).

Document checks by the Financial Crime Agent's Document Authenticity assistant for Felix (Financial Crime): the death certificate and Robert's ID are legitimate, and the details match Life Advice Guru's client records. ✅

Used for: the death claim on Corella Life policy CR-19033105, and the separate death claim with Riverbend Super's trustee for Mei's default death cover of $180,000 (see 'Case REQ-20261113-LIF005 — super fund cover note').

Privacy: the certificate is shared only with the people who need it — Claims, Financial Crime, Amelia and the insurer or fund handling each claim.
